description: resume_logging on an asleep vehicle that stays asleep: derived from vehicle_resume_asleep, but the poll after the call finds the vehicle still asleep. resume_logging sets the asleep interval to one second; the asleep payload then hits the doubling clause (interval unequal to the asleep interval), which doubles the interval up to the asleep interval and writes and publishes nothing — repeat-neutral, the doubling itself is timing and not visible. Pinned: the ok reply in the calls section and the single asleep row; no stream connect. No await.
